baseline: Latest FC1+DW8 graph with prior preprocessing
candidate: Identical graph and weights with equivalent crop-aware bicubic resize
settings: FP32 CPU, intra=4, inter=1, sequential, graph optimization all, spinning off, existing governor
correctness: All five seeds: parameter bytes unchanged, pixels and FP32 input bitwise identical; paired logits bitwise identical; latest graph vs original and prior five-seed references allclose(atol=rtol=2e-4), predictions identical; no nonfinite outputs or throttling
promotion: Report all runs. Promote crop resize only if overall five-seed mean total latency improves and at least 4 of 5 paired seed means improve. Do not interpret pure-inference timing change as crop benefit. No significance claim.
timing: Two fresh processes per variant per seed; full run then within-seed means; SD across five seed means. Offline warm-cache total includes decode/preprocess, inference, softmax/argmax; excludes camera, network and session initialization.
